# Contributing

When contributing to this repository, please first discuss the change you wish to make via issue,
email, or any other method with the owners of this repository before making a change.

Please note we have a [code of conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md), please follow it in all your
interactions with the project.

## Pull Request Process

1. Keep each pull request to one concern: a single skill, `CLAUDE.md`, or `statusline.pl`.
2. Keep skill references consistent: a skill's `name:` field matches its folder name, and
   `CLAUDE.md` and the README refer to it by that name.
3. Update the README when you add or remove a skill or change the utilities a skill needs.
4. Test `statusline.pl` changes by piping sample status JSON into it.
